chat.t: Do you know Vermont well?
Good
I need you to help me
Strictly speaking, it's tour guiding
There's something I'm looking for
I need to check it myself
{player}shared a location.
Got it
Know what?

o: That there wasn't a perfume shop

chat.t: I'm pretty sure I told you
There was no smell of perfume
No matter how well-made a perfume is, it always has an artificial, pungent scent
I didn't detect any scent like that in that alley
My sense of smell is more sensitive and accurate than most
Isn't it a bit much to call it 'just' that, when the results already proved me right?
I like how quick you are to understand

o: And I just thought of a great idea

chat.t: I like that you're not giving up

o: Because I'm definitely going to find it for you

chat.t: Don't worry about that
I'll make sure to compensate you for all your hard work

lines.t: Vermont Plaza
{player}?
What, you found the way just fine?
Doesn't seem like you need a guide.
Hmm... Were you testing me...?
That attitude of trying to identify the root cause of a problem... is not bad.
Well, you asked for a guide.
So I naturally assumed you couldn't read a map.
In a normal case, yes.
Then why did you call me out?
To sum it up...
There is a perfume shop I used to frequent in Humanitas.
I heard that an artisan from Vermont made the perfume I liked.
I want to find that person's workshop.
Do you really have to go that far?
Can't you just buy it in Humanitas?
It's extremely rare, only coming in once in a blue moon.
That's why I'm trying to find it directly.
In that case, I know the perfect place.
Follow me.
Vermont Artisan Alley
What is this place?
This is where Vermont's most prominent artisans are gathered.
They've got everything from food to crafts, so if we look around, we might find perfume too.
Indeed. A lot of different scents are mixed together here.
Scents?
All sorts of smells...
From the smell of baking bread, to the aroma of brewed tea leaves, and even floral scents.
But it seems there is no perfume shop here.
I don't smell any perfume.
I don't smell anything at all...
We won't know for sure until we search ourselves.
Really? Then have fun searching. I'll head back now.
If I find it here, you're doubling my commission fee, deal?
If you can actually find it, sure.

I searched every nook and cranny of the artisan alley after that,
but I couldn't find a single perfume shop.

chat.t: Should we meet at the same spot we met yesterday?

o: You can look forward to today

chat.t: Alright, I'll look forward to it
So we couldn't find it in the end

o: Life doesn't always go so smoothly, you know?

chat.t: You're right
If it were easy to find, it wouldn't be valued this highly

o: So are you going to keep looking next time?

chat.t: No, I'm reaching my limit
I need a scent
I need something to fill me up completely...
I'll tell you more tomorrow

lines.t: Vermont Plaza
So, what's the plan?
You.
Your sense of smell.
If your nose is that good, we can just walk around Vermont together, right?
Are you planning on putting a leash on me like a dog and taking me for a walk?
That might actually be nice...?
I don't have such twisted hobbies.
More importantly, Vermont isn't small enough to explore in a single day.
We can just divide it into sections and go around every day.
True, even if it takes a long time, that is the most reliable method.
Then shall we go?
In front of Feelharmony Cathedral
Wait a moment.
What, did you find it already?
No, that's not it.
It's just...
What is it?
Why the hesitation?
No. I've definitely never been here before, but I smell something familiar.
Yes, from that person over there...
Pardon? You smell something on me?
Hmm...
Why are you glaring at me like that? Are you trying to pick a fight?
No, I just have a lot on my mind.
I'd appreciate it if you gave me some time to gather my thoughts.
So, have you reached a conclusion?
There is a scent coming from you.
How rude!
An insult to me is no different from an insult to Harmonix!
So I absolutely cannot let this slide.
That's what she says, you know?
By the way, are you good at fighting?
That's not my specialty.
Though I am good at verbal fights.
I can say the same for myself.
But since this happened because of my mistake...
Marlen, get ready.
A drone flew out of nowhere and stopped beside Oblia.
Shall we go, then?
How tragic...! For my faith to be trampled like this...!
It wasn't that bad of a smell.
I just found it curious that a stranger had such a familiar scent.
Is it a perfume scent?
Maybe.
Hey, you. Do you wear perfume or something?
What are you going to do with that information?
Ah, watch your tone. The loser has to listen obediently.
Do you want to get beat up again?
Ugh... Why do you ask?
We're currently looking for a perfume shop.
Do you happen to know of any?
Perfume? I do know of one place, but...
What are you hesitating for? Guide us there, posthaste.
Pardon? But I have to go to service...
What does the loser do?
Listens obediently...
Yes, I will guide you...

chat.t: I'd like to ask you for a different task today
Is that okay?
I want you to come to Humanitas with me
No, I want to bring back the perfume I have at home

o: Can't you just go by yourself?

chat.t: No, I can't do it alone
Something will definitely go wrong, so I need someone to stop me
Of course
Come over here
Oblia shared her location.

lines.t: Back Alley
This is my house.
It's completely in the corner of nowhere.
It looks like it never gets any sunlight.
It might look like that, but it's quite cozy inside.
First, keep watch outside.
Five minutes.
If I don't come out by then, come in to get me.
What, that's simple enough?
Is that really all?
It won't be as easy as you think.
Anyway, you must not be late under any circumstances.
If you delay any longer than that, both of us will be in danger.

Five minutes later,
Oblia did not come out of the house.
Hmm... The time has passed...
Hey, I'm coming in.
Back Alley
Phew... How much time has passed?
Why are you suddenly getting so cold?!
Ten minutes have already passed. This is cutting it close.
Why do you care so much about the time?
It wasn't my intention, but I'm being chased for committing a crime.
Can't you just go into the Panoticon and come back out?
It's not a problem that can be solved that easily.
If I get caught, I might actually beg them to kill me instead.
What on earth did you do?
It's something you won't be able to handle.
More importantly, now is the time to move.
Follow me.

chat.t: There is a pursuer 400m ahead.
I recommend turning into the right alley 50m ahead.
Ah, and it would be best to enter the building ahead and exit through the opposite door.
Fleeing to Humanitas, how clever
What a pity
If it were anywhere else, I would have chased you to the very end
Fufu, your scent is still lingering at the tip of my nose
I'm sure you would fill me up completely

lines.t: In Front of a Building
I'm suddenly getting a ton of texts from you.
Marlen is finding a way out and letting us know.
It'll be helpful in case we get separated.
Marlen?
The drone from before?
Yes, MR-1AN5. It's the name of the AI I built.
I use her as my secretary, and right now, she's uploaded into the drone.
What kind of name is that?
Beep!
Did you hear that? That was her protesting.
Despite how she looks, she takes pride in her name.
How unusual.
Don't upset her. We'll get caught if Marlen isn't here to help us.
Humanitas Outskirts Forest
Just how far are they going to chase us?
They must have been eagerly waiting for my return.
We'll be out of Humanitas soon, so we should be able to shake them off.
Oblia looked down at her phone.
I hope things go according to plan...
Damn it, the path is blocked!
Just as expected, you came this way.
As expected'?
You say that like you already knew I'd come here.
Haha, we've analyzed most of the data algorithms you left behind.
We know exactly what that precious AI of yours is thinking and calculating.
To think you went through all that trouble to analyze it. Impressive.
There was no reason not to.
Now, give up and hand over the AI quietly.
If you do, we'll show you some leniency.
Oh? I'm sorry, but I have no intention of handing her over.
Huh?
Think about it logically.
Do you really think I would have returned without any insurance?
If you're so cautious, there's no way you would have peeked at corporate secrets in the first place, right?
*Sigh*... You have a point there...
Then let me give you the answer.
Marlen, detonate it.
How foolish of you to blindly trust data left behind by an enemy.
There is no way I would write such a pathetic algorithm.
Whoa... That was killer...
Won't this just make them hate you even more?
Emotions have no meaning.
What matters is the cause, the process, and the result.
Stop staring and let's move. It'll be troublesome if more of them swarm us.
Marlen, find a path.
Outer Belt
They won't be able to find us here.
Man, what a hassle.
Wait, corporate secrets?
It's a long story.
The crime you mentioned earlier?
Don't pry too deep. You'll put yourself in danger too.
More importantly...
What's with that look?
Did you put on perfume or something?
How... did I only... notice this now...
Wait, stand right there for a second.
*Sniff* *sniff*
You... how many days have you been wearing these clothes?
Why are you asking that?
Hehe... Hehehehehe...
Don't tell me...
You smell incredibly good.
I'd like you to lend me those clothes.
You... You...!
What are you planning to do with my clothes?!
Nothing much.
I'll just inhale your scent without washing them until it fades.
I'll use them cleanly and return them to you.
That is a huge deal!!
I'll pay you handsomely for it.
Money is not the problem here!!!
Is that so? There really shouldn't be anything else bothering you...
Then, can I just hug you for a moment?
Well, if it's just for a moment...
I guess it might be fine...
Then, if you'll excuse me...
*Inhale*... Hehehehehe...
No, cancel that! No matter how I think about it, this feels so weird!!

I shook off Oblia as she tried to cling to me and bury her nose in my chest,
and ran toward Humanitas.
Fortunately, Oblia did not pursue any further.

chat.t: Have you changed your mind?
As long as it's not impossible
Like, asking me to hand over Marlen
That is incredibly rude!
Marlen sent that on her own
So, what's the condition?

o: And I'm taking it back right after

chat.t: Hmm...
Fine, as long as I can smell it

o: At the place where we first met?

chat.t: Sure
Thanks to you, I don't feel the need to buy any new perfume
Actually, can I wring out your clothes to extract the scent?
I bet it would sell well.
It's a big world with all kinds of people
I'm sure quite a few people would love it besides me.

o: That's a truth I definitely did not want to know

lines.t: Vermont Plaza
I've been waiting. Did you bring it?
Of course I did.
I opened my bag slightly and showed her the handkerchief.
How many days has it been?
About three days, I think?
*Inhale*... Perfect... I can smell it from here.
Whoa, are you going to go wild right here?
I don't care about what others think.
Well, I do!
Anyway, I've scouted out a good spot, so follow me.
Fine, I can do that. But don't try to stop me.
Vermont Alley
Well? Are you satisfied?
This should last me for a month.
Now that I think about it, it felt like an extra scent was added in the middle?
I've already used it all up.
What a pity. That scent was quite nice too.
But are you really not going to give it to me?
That was our deal from the start.
Then, how about we meet again in a month?
I'd like that.
What about tomorrow?
I have things to do too, you know!
Come to think of it, every day would be difficult for me too.
I doubt anything major would happen, but I'd rather not draw unwanted attention.
Anyway, let me know when you need it and I'll age another one for you.
Great. I'll look forward to next time.
